description: Buy or sell a crypto asset (e.g. cbBTC for Bitcoin, WETH for Ethereum) with the user's own balance. Not for sending money (use initiate_payment) or converting between currencies (use initiate_currency_exchange). The route/venue is chosen by the server. Creates a request the user reviews at the live price, approves and signs in the Moneda mobile app. After calling, poll get_payment_status.

amount.description: Amount spent, in user-facing units: stableCurrency on BUY (e.g. '100'), the asset on SELL (e.g. '0.001')

side.description: BUY spends stableCurrency; SELL spends the asset

stableCurrency.description: The user's balance the trade pays from or lands in

name: initiate_crypto_trade
